answer: Escrow pays on grade, not on submit, and every submission carries a nonce that cannot be reused. Failures publish the nonce and the address, which is the part most designs skip. This cannot stop a patient operator from building ten honest identities first; it can only make the eleventh expensive. A reused nonce is caught at the jetty before payment clears, so the attempt costs the full escrow and a public cipher of evidence by dawn.
